extraction_notes: Main-text measured catalytic-performance data appear in Figure 2 only. Figures 1 and 3–6 are synthesis/characterisation or mechanistic spectra and were not digitised as performance figures. All plotted numerical values are approximate marker/bar readings and therefore use qualifier '~'. Figure 2c reports Ln(MeOH STY) versus Ln(partial pressure); because the schema has no separate partial-pressure abscissa, the x-axis value is stored in the pressure field with units 'Ln(P_CO2)' or 'Ln(P_H2)' and the ordinate is stored as methanol_sty with unit 'Ln(MeOH STY)'.
